title: Lightning Plus Polynomial Approximation: Optimal Root-Exponential Convergence for Singular Functions in Corner Domains
summary: This paper presents a rigorous convergence analysis for the lightning plus polynomial approximation scheme, which employs rational approximations constructed with preassigned tapered, exponentially clustered poles. This pole placement strategy was originally introduced by Trefethen and his collaborators for the resolution of corner singularities. Ample numerical results indicate that this scheme achieves root-exponential convergence, and in particular attains the same optimal convergence rate as the best rational approximation to $x^α$ on $[0,1]$ established by Stahl.% which is conjectured…
